title: gomphrena pulchella var. haenkeana
intro: Gomphrena pulchella var. haenkeana, commonly known as 'Red Globe Amaranth', is a plant species within the Amaranthaceae family, known for its vibrant red flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Gomphrena pulchella var. haenkeana include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory agent, reduce oxidative stress, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, reduce fever, and treat various skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gomphrena pulchella var. haenkeana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
